edits:
- release/1-integration
      - name: Platform and integration contracts
        run: npm test

      - name: Experience contract
        run: npm run test:experience

      - name: Analytics contract
        run: npx tsc -p tsconfig.analytics.json && node scripts/verify-analytics-contract.mjs


      - name: Install browser
        run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Verify production-bundle browser behavior
        run: npm run test:browser

      - name: Preserve browser evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release-1-browser-evidence
          path: test-results/release-1
          if-no-files-found: ignore

"firebase:deploy": "npm run build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest deploy --only hosting --project nurture-12398",
    "test:experience": "node scripts/verify-experience-entitlements.mjs",
    "test:browser": "node scripts/verify-release-browser.mjs"
    "vitest": "^4.1.11",
    "@playwright/test": "^1.58.0"
